senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. גני) [to be covered, surrounded,] to encamp, rest.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11">Num. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <he>ויחנך</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 6:25">Num. VI, 25</cite>) <he>יַחֲנֶה ד׳ אצלך</he> the Lord have His tent with thee. Lam. R. introd. (R. Naḥm.) (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 29:1">Is. XXIX, 1</cite>) <he>שח׳ בה וכ׳</he> where David (lawfully) resided, v. <cite ref="H01284"><he>חַנְיָיא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Isaiah 29:1">Ib.</cite> (R. Alex. 1) <he>נוסעים … וחוֹנִים וכ׳</he> they moved in discord and encamped in discord; Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 1; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite>; a. fr.—Apocop. form: <cite ref="H01247"><he>חָן</he></cite> (as if from <he>חון</he>).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 47</cite> (play on <he>ב̇ח̇נ̇מ̇ל</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105:7">ib.</cite>) <he>ב̇א ח̇ן̇ מ̇ל̇</he> he (the locust) came, encamped, cut; (Tanḥ. Vaëra 14 <he>בא נ״ח מ״ל</he>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 12">Ex. R. s. 12</cite> interpol. from Midr. Till. l. c.: <cite ref="N00468"><he>נח</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to cause to rest. Fut. apocop. יַחַן. Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ (play on י̇ח̇נ̇יף̇, Num. XXXV, 33) הדם י̇ח̇ן אף̇ וכ׳ bloodshed causes the anger (of the Lord) to rest upon the ground (rain being withheld); Sifré Num. 161, Yalk. ib. 788 יחון (corr. acc.).
